title: CAN-Bus Telemetry Frame Ring Buffer
scenario: An Electronic Control Unit (ECU) in a connected vehicle receives high-frequency Controller Area Network (CAN) bus telemetry frames (speed, RPM, brake pressure, battery voltage) over an interrupt line. The onboard MCU has constrained memory and must log telemetry frames into a fixed-size ring buffer without dynamically allocating memory or dropping critical emergency priority frames.
algorithmic_pattern: Circular Queue / Ring Buffer using head and tail index wrap-around with modular arithmetic.
sample_constraints: Fixed capacity N up to 4096 frames
O(1) enqueue and dequeue operations without heap allocations
Priority frames (ID < 0x100) must overwrite standard frames when buffer is full
example_problem_flavor: Implement a real-time TelemetryRingBuffer with push(), pop(), and peek_emergency() operations conforming to strict memory limits.

title: Temperature Sensor Outlier Noise Filter
scenario: Industrial temperature probes in a battery management system suffer from transient electromagnetic spikes that introduce corrupted outlier readings. A real-time moving window median/average filter is applied to the digital signal stream before sending data to the battery cooling controller.
algorithmic_pattern: Sliding Window with moving sum or two pointers for window boundary maintenance.
sample_constraints: Window size K between 3 and 101 (odd numbers)
Continuous data stream of up to 100,000 sensor readings
Return the smoothed sensor signal sequence
example_problem_flavor: Filter noise spikes from a digital sensor stream by replacing sudden transient spikes with the local moving average.
